description: External E2E Activity Lifecycle Validation Harness - tests complete lifecycle with DB verification

metadata.purpose: Validate complete activity lifecycle using only external tools
externalTools: Compiled OpenCode binary (no dev code access)

testPhases.name: Template Storage Verification
testPhases.validates: Templates can be stored in database

testPhases.name: Template Execution + Storage Verification
testPhases.method: Execute template via CLI, query activity_execution table
testPhases.validates: Templates can be executed and executions are recorded

testPhases.name: Log Analysis
testPhases.method: Analyze validation logs for errors and lifecycle indicators

exports.ValidationInput: Input type with DB connection, OpenCode binary path, expected values
exports.ValidationOutput: Output type with pass/fail, actual vs expected, errors, evidence

usage.programmatic: import { runValidation } from './external-e2e-activity-lifecycle-validation-harness'; const result = await runValidation(input);
usage.withTestCase: const testCase = require('./impulses/validation-external-e2e-activity-lifecycle-validation-case-1.json'); const result = await runValidation(testCase.input);

metadata.successCriteria: 2/3 phases must pass for overall PASS

outputFormat.actual: object with phase1, phase2, phase3 results
outputFormat.expected: object with expected values for comparison
